items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: He said, 'Pop did me wrong.' ... He said, 'I ain't never sassed him, I never did him nothin'. And I was just talking, and he hauled off and slapped me.'

ctx.x: This ain't a place for you, stopping in a little one-horse town like this." We said, "Come on." He said, "Yeah, but Pop did me wrong." (He called him Pop.) He said, "I ain't never sassed him, I never did him nothin'. And I was just talking, and he hauled off and slapped me." He said, "I couldn't take it. I left." We left and he stayed a while... Like, the show was there for a week. This must have happened around about Tuesday. And we were going to leave Sunday, going to Minneapolis. Naturally, we didn't want to…
How long was he away for?
